purpose: Recent benchmark/environment figure research; Hugging Face monthly discovery plus primary-source screening.
selection_policy: Convenience sample emphasizing relevant highly upvoted month entries and diversity of evaluation contracts. Votes measure community attention, not scientific validity or visual design quality.
vote_policy: Record the visible number immediately preceding the title on the monthly listing, not GitHub star counts after titles. Values can differ from live paper-page votes; e.g. SocialOmni was 247 on month listing and 248 on paper page; ALE 391 vs 393. No explicit monthly rank was recorded.

papers.design_inference: Stateful sandbox, task policies, tool calls, and outcome checks must be distinct.
Separate full-video perception from prefix-only interaction; show a timing gate before generated speech.
Separate task construction from load/start/evaluate lifecycle; show agent-visible inputs and evaluator-only references.
Show release-to-release changes and fixed task identity; distinguish step success from whole-chain success.
Separate case context, diagnostic routing, rollout evidence, and score aggregation.
Align reset/action/observation interfaces across variants so the intervention location is visible.
Separate image/text conditioning from generated sequence and hidden symbolic ground truth; identify in-domain and held-out task sets.
Show the required artifact bundle and the full-completion gate; do not equate partial credit with task completion.
Distinguish recovered workspace, generated task, and interaction session; show breadth and depth as separate expansion axes.
Show environment state, supplier events, order lifecycle, and different feedback delays; separate simulator and agent clocks.
Use a concrete source passage and target graph/structure to define the task; reserve model reasoning for the method figure.
Show repository harvesting, runnable environment construction, test validation, and release packaging as distinct stages.
Distinguish the city state from first-person observations and map access; show route changes and moving pedestrians as environment dynamics.
Draw repeated rollouts from the same initial condition and compare outcome distributions, not only one plausible clip.
Expose the fixed prompt, runtime budget, workspace, patch extraction, and evaluator contract around interchangeable agent harnesses.
Separate specification, produced game artifact, executable replay, and judge; a static screenshot alone cannot define gameplay evaluation.
Show revealed history versus current observation, and distinguish forgetting from action choice; mark controlled difficulty axes.

visual_reviews.identity: Author README benchmark overview; feature/construction panels over a concrete failed enterprise episode.
observations: The lower row makes policy, executed tool calls, environment records, and failed SQL checks legible as one example.
Numbered construction stages occupy a separate panel from agent execution.
visual_reviews.transfer: Pair one concrete episode with a smaller construction strip when both matter.
visual_reviews.caution: Dense text and heavy panel borders consume considerable space; do not copy the full poster-like density.
visual_reviews.inspection_method: GitHub fetch_file base64 rendered as image; source artwork not saved in repository

visual_reviews.identity: Author overview with benchmark composition, task design, and performance columns.
observations: The middle column changes video access from full context to a prefix.
The interaction task branches at an interruption decision before language generation and scoring.
visual_reviews.transfer: Draw information access and conditional actions explicitly.
visual_reviews.caution: The broad taxonomy ring and two radar plots are not necessary for a dedicated setup figure; task contract deserves the area.

visual_reviews.identity: Author benchmark overview: terminal release sequence, software milestones, and changing preference example.
observations: Repeated terminal cards preserve the goal while visibly changing paths, package availability, privilege, and implementation.
Other panels use milestone and conversation sequences instead of forcing all domains into one glyph.
visual_reviews.transfer: Use aligned repeated state snapshots to reveal what changes and what persists across releases.
visual_reviews.caution: Do not conflate these release transitions with ordinary within-episode environment steps.

visual_reviews.identity: Author evaluation pipeline: case, skill routing, frame-grounded reasoning, score.
observations: A concrete robot scene and prompt anchor the abstract evaluator stages.
A red frame crop locates the unexpected human intervention that supports a diagnostic judgment.
visual_reviews.transfer: Connect every diagnostic judgment to the actual observable artifact or frame that supports it.
visual_reviews.caution: Evaluator sub-agents are not the system under test; label the boundary to prevent role confusion.

visual_reviews.identity: Author environment overview with merchant agent, supplier/store/order simulation, and evaluation.
observations: Nested regions separate the merchant from the persistent environment and evaluation.
The order lifecycle is visibly sequential; feedback arrows distinguish fast supplier changes from delayed order outcomes.
The evaluation panel states different agent and simulator time steps.
visual_reviews.transfer: Represent multiple clocks and feedback latency when they determine benchmark difficulty.
visual_reviews.caution: The overview's broad bidirectional arrows do not identify exact action payloads; a new figure should label action and observation directions separately.
visual_reviews.inspection_method: GitHub fetch_file base64 rendered as image; source artwork not saved in repository

visual_reviews.identity: Author component comparison, corresponding to paper Figure 3 interface overview.
observations: Four columns retain reset/step/observation alignment while moving the intervention to the relevant interface.
The frozen environment remains visibly unchanged; selective colored arrows show which interface is transformed.
Short code excerpts substantiate the operations beneath the diagrams.
visual_reviews.transfer: Use same geometry and selective emphasis for controlled setup variants.
visual_reviews.caution: Author repository uses Setup/Rule/Link labels while the retrieved PDF prose also uses Stage/Contract/Chain; bind terminology to the selected source version.

limitations: Only six actual images were visually inspected; remaining entries are explicitly text-only.
The ALE author teaser was fetched but could not be processed as an image; it is not counted as a visual review.
Hugging Face month reflects listing/submission month, not necessarily arXiv identifier month (e.g. MerchantBench and SWE-rebench V2).
Several arXiv HTML/abstract and HF link requests failed; accessible primary repository or alternate official paper representations were used.
The sample is not exhaustive and does not establish a best-paper ranking or empirically prove design superiority.
